description: Time series of one ratio or reported field for FDIC-insured banks, 2018-03 to 2026-06. Give cert (the FDIC certificate number) for one bank. Otherwise it aggregates all domestic insured banks matching the optional state (2-letter code) / size_band (1-5: under $100M, $100M-$500M, $500M-$1B, $1B-$10B, $10B+, by quarter-end assets) / min_assets filters: aggregate='median' (default for ratios), 'mean', 'sum' (default for dollar fields), 'pooled' (the system-wide version of a ratio: total numerators over total denominators), or 'count'. group_by='size_band' or 'state' returns one row per group (defaults to the latest quarter). All income and expense fields are year to date as reported and reset each January; assets, deposits and loans are quarter-end balances. Ratios are fractions (0.62 = 62%). Per-bank rows carry the merger_event flag; year-to-date ratios in a merger quarter span both institutions. For credit unions use metric_series. Fields: efficiency_ratio (noninterest expense over net interest income plus noninterest income), roa_ytd, net_interest_margin_ytd, noninterest_income_share (noninterest income over net interest income plus noninterest income); assets, deposits, loans, net_income_ytd, interest_income_ytd, interest_expense_ytd, net_interest_income_ytd, noninterest_income_ytd, noninterest_expense_ytd; employees_fte_reported (reported bank FTE from FDIC NUMEMP, not headcount).
name: bank_metric_series
